reading.body:
This entry is not a data center; it is an inactive web-development business mistagged in OpenStreetMap, with zero megawatts and no published specifications.

The listed name describes web design work, its domain is a parked for-sale page, and the stored address resolves to a different current occupant. No public evidence ties the location to server infrastructure or colocation equipment, so the record is a false positive rather than a facility.

For AI infrastructure, this contributes nothing: zero megawatts means no compute or power demand to count. The data offers no signal about grid constraints or capacity in Arizona, only a reminder that unfiltered datasets can inflate apparent data center counts with defunct small businesses.
